Class AuthDigest

java.lang.Object
net.apexes.fetion4j.core.client.auth.AuthDigest
public class AuthDigest extends Object
Represents the SIPC authentication digest exchanged during registration (W header in the response, A header in the request). Parses and generates digest strings in the format: 
Digest algorithm="SHA1-sess-v4",nonce="1D3C",key="C3C7",signature="84E8"
Since:
3.0.0

@Loong Wan
